correctness.rationale: For regular wandering orbits the derivative formulas (2.4), (3.1), (3.2) in arXiv:2206.09508v1 give the signed stretch count. For non-axis tangent directions the logarithm of the Euclidean norm is within a bounded additive constant of the dominant stretch. The geometric sums imply uniform normalized-block convergence to |u-c|/(u+d); weighted Riemann sums yield the full one-parameter weak-limit family and compactness establishes exhaustion. Direct inversion gives the CDFs and a strictly positive difference in the interior. The attached checker passed finite algebraic/numerical tests; no inference of infinite validity from finite tests is made.

value.rationale: The positive-area wandering set is noteworthy precisely because its finite-time Lyapunov rates are irregular. The known accumulation interval does not measure frequencies. This new theorem specifies every possible subsequential time-histogram law, an explicit universal rational block-end CDF and a strictly different intra-block CDF, which quantitatively diagnoses nonconvergence of temporal spectral statistics rather than merely observing nonconvergence of single rates.
